text:
kelly: dropped v3 mock for the trace header — trying a three-cluster pattern: left = navigation (Back / Open full trace), center = quick actions (Copy IDs, Pin Span), right = overflow (Export, Permalink, Download). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz987/trace-header-v3 :sparkles:

ajay: nice. question: should Pin Span be persistent (sticky) or just client-side UI? customers asked for a way to bookmark a failing span across sessions.

kelly: for Dedicated we can surface sticky pins saved to user prefs, but default for hosted should be session-only. visual: small pin icon with active state.

tom: backend note: if we make pins persistent we need an endpoint to save a pinned span id set. small API work but doable.

maria: UX: if pinning exists, add a counter and quick filter "Show pinned only" in the trace list. Also pin tooltip: "Pin span to top of trace view" not just "Pin".

sam: copy flow: proposing Copy IDs become a split button — primary action copies trace id, caret opens a menu: Copy trace id, Copy request id, Copy correlation chain. That avoids extra clicks.

ajay: agree on split button. question about wording for correlation chain: some users call it "correlation ids" vs "trace parents". Keep it generic: "Copy correlation chain"

kelly: good call. also thinking about representing correlation ids as clickable chips in the header so users can copy a single id. chips would have a copy icon and tooltip.

tom: chips are cool but watch visual density on small widths. collapse chips into a single "IDs" popup on narrow screens.

maria: accessibility: each chip needs aria-label like "Copy correlation id 1234-abc" and role=button. Add focus style and keyboard handling (Space/Enter).

a11y-bot: checklist: ensure chips are in tab order, use aria-describedby for tooltips, announce copy success via polite aria-live region, and ensure the split button has aria-expanded and aria-controls. Color contrast for active pin state must be >= 4.5:1.

sam: export placement: prefer overflow kebab. Export is infrequent and we don't want to distract primary troubleshooting actions. But add a small badge on export when full event JSON > 5MB to warn about size.

ajay: how should Export modal present choices? two presets: "Stack frames (CSV)" and "Full event (JSON)" + advanced toggle with fields. Show estimated size before download.

tom: backend will return a size estimate if we add a header. can show a quick spinner and size hint. export should respect user's timezone and format timestamps in ISO by default.

kelly: microcopy suggestions: change "Download" to explicit labels: "Export stack frames (CSV)", "Export full event (JSON)", and keep "Get permalink" not just "Permalink".

maria: keyboard nav: ensure overflow menu is reachable via keyboard (Enter to open) and arrow keys to move. pressing Escape closes and returns focus to kebab. Provide a visible focus ring on all action icons.

a11y-bot: also note: for screen readers, the export modal should set aria-modal=true and trap focus. Escape should close and restore focus to the trigger. Use role=dialog and labelledby pointing to modal title.

sam: minor: change copy toast copy from "Copied" to context: "Trace ID copied to clipboard. Paste into support ticket." helps non-technical users.

ajay: mobile: collapse to two clusters: nav + kebab. show Copy IDs as an item in the kebab on phone.

kelly: I'll update the mock with chips fallback, split copy button, and kebab-only mobile. Will add annotations for aria attributes and focus order. Can I get quick dev + a11y review once uploaded?

maria: I'll review behavior notes. tom will confirm API hooks.

tom: will sync on API. can we target engineering groom for Wednesday?

kelly: yes i'll upload frames by EOD and tag folks. thanks! :raised_hands:
